tools.name: ganttpro_get_team
tools.description: Get the GanttPRO team that the API key belongs to. Good first call to confirm the key works.

tools.name: ganttpro_list_projects
tools.description: List the projects in the team. Use the projectId values with the task tools.

tools.name: ganttpro_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by its projectId.

tools.name: ganttpro_get_task_fields
tools.description: Get the task fields (including custom fields) defined for one or more projects.

tools.name: ganttpro_get_project_calendars
tools.description: Get the calendars used by the team's projects, including working days and custom days.

tools.name: ganttpro_list_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks of one or more projects, with optional filters. Status and priority are the numeric codes the API defines (status 1-4, priority 1-5).

tools.name: ganttpro_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by its taskId.

tools.name: ganttpro_list_resources
tools.description: List the resources (people or equipment) that can be assigned to tasks.

tools.name: ganttpro_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the team.

tools.name: ganttpro_get_user
tools.description: Get one user by its userId.

tools.name: ganttpro_list_comments
tools.description: List the comments on one or more tasks.

tools.name: ganttpro_list_time_logs
tools.description: List the time logs reported on one or more tasks.

tools.name: ganttpro_get_link
tools.description: Get one dependency link between two tasks by its linkId.

tools.name: ganttpro_create_task
tools.description: Create a task in a project. Name and projectId are required. The API defaults are status 1, progress 0, priority 3, color 1, duration 1 working day, starting at the first working hour of today. Creates a new task on every call.

tools.name: ganttpro_update_task
tools.description: Change only the fields you pass on one task. Passing only startDate re-calculates endDate. Repeating the same call leaves the task the same.

tools.name: ganttpro_add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a task as one user. Creates a new comment on every call.

tools.name: ganttpro_add_time_log
tools.description: Report time spent on a task by one resource. Creates a new time log on every call.

tools.name: ganttpro_create_link
tools.description: Create a dependency link from one task to another. Creates a new link on every call.
